facts.value: As part of your studies in another department, you can complete certain modules in our Department of Economics, known as export modules. This includes optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: For the degree programs of other departments, an overview has been compiled of which export modules you can register for in the Department of Economics and how you can integrate these export modules into your degree program in your home department.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Furthermore, you cannot integrate other modules from the Department of Economics into your degree program in another department and also cannot earn differing Credit Points (CP) in the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL
